chapter: Tulsa bands, Trent, Holder and Kirk
title: Eddie Heywood Jr. and the autographed picture
summary: Fields later met Heywood Jr., who played the Apollo and Royal with his band, and recalls Marshal Royal playing in Heywood's combo.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: It would just tickle him to death and everything, and later on, I met his son, and he told me his dad had told him about me and his son--after I had my big band--he was one of the features at the Apollo Theatre and the Royal Theatre with my band.
And he had a small combo and at that time, in his band, he had bad boys--Ernie Royal was the trumpet player, wasn't he? What is the saxophone player's name?
Marshal Royal was playing with him, was playing with Eddie Heyward Jr.
Yes, I saw them at Shep's Playhouse in Los Angeles during the war.
Yes, he was playing with him.
Later on, before this is over,
I'll show you a picture that Butterbeans and Eddie gave me, autographed, wishing me luck and everything.
